faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Trading signals are precise alerts or recommendations sent by expert analysts or algorithms, indicating when to buy or sell a financial asset (Forex, Synthetic Indices, Cryptocurrencies) including Entry prices, Take Profit, and Stop Loss.
faq.q2: How does automated risk management work?
faq.a2: Our tool automatically calculates the appropriate lot size for your trade based on your account size and the exact percentage you are willing to risk (e.g. 1%). This prevents you from blowing your account due to overleveraging.
faq.q3: Does it work for trading Synthetic Indices and Forex?
faq.a3: Yes, our platform and signals cover a wide range of markets including the foreign exchange market (Forex), Stock Indices, and Synthetic Indices (Boom, Crash, Volatility, Step).
faq.q4: Do I have to connect my broker to the platform?
faq.a4: For security, you maintain total control of your capital. We send you the signal and precise risk parameters, and you execute the order in your trusted broker (like Deriv, MetaTrader 4/5, etc).
faq.q5: What is the trading journal or Kardex?
faq.a5: It is an automated digital record (journaling) where you can document all your trades, analyze your win rate, and discover patterns in your trading to improve your long-term consistency.
faq.q6: I have a trading academy, can I use your platform?
faq.a6: Absolutely! We offer a B2B ecosystem where academies can use our technology to manage their students, sell automated recurring subscriptions, and send their own trading signals in a closed and professional environment.
faq.q7: How do payments and subscriptions work?
faq.a7: We accept secure payments through recognized gateways like MercadoPago. You can choose monthly, semi-annual, or annual billing cycles. All access to signals and the academy is activated immediately after payment.
faq.q8: Do I need previous trading experience?
faq.a8: No. If you are a beginner, our 'Integrated Academy' will teach you from the basics to advanced strategies. While you learn, you can leverage our professional signals to seek profitability.
faq.q9: What happens if I lose trades?
faq.a9: Trading carries inherent risks and losses are part of the professional process. Our promise is to provide strict risk management (calculated Stop Loss) so that losses are always controlled and mathematically minimized.
faq.q10: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a10: Yes. You can manage your subscription directly from your user profile. There are no mandatory permanence clauses, although we recommend annual plans for the great savings and long-term commitment.
